==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am standing behind a large window. Peering through the window I see a bunch of garbage piled up in yellow grass. It looks like there might have been a party overnight in the clearing. Two women go outside to clean up the garbage. They break open some barrels in the garbage pile. Two lions leap out of the broken barrels and attack the women. I accompany a very angry man inside of a military mech suit. The angry man is training to get revenge on whoever set up the lion trap. I try to calm the angry man down, but I am asked to leave by a female pilot instructor.
